description: adws/adw_interface_scala_file_scan.py -- check_seen -> check_mazda -> read_text -> classify -> file -> report. Leaves receipts/statements to Mazda, OCRs the page with tesseract, files by pattern rules at >= 0.90 or else asks Haiku, copies (never moves) into C:\Users\NewUser\scanned_documents\<folder>, and records one line in ~/scala/ledger.jsonl.
